# Mali Franzese

> Founder-Engineer at The MASS Lab, an independent software practice based in Texas.
> Builds and ships production multi-tenant SaaS platforms end to end, with AI-assisted
> development as a core method. Currently pursuing a B.S. in Cybersecurity at Western
> Governors University.

Also known as: Anomali007 (handle, GitHub and personal site).
Not affiliated with Anomali Incorporated, the cybersecurity company.
Not related to Michael Franzese or Sonny Franzese.

## Primary

- [Blog](https://anomali007.com/blog): notes on AI-assisted engineering practice.

## Practice and products

- [The MASS Lab](https://themasslab.com): the engineering practice. Legal entity MASS LLC.
- [MASS Lab Connect](https://masslabconnect.com): managed AI that answers, routes and books
  customer calls, with an auditable record of every interaction.
- [Token Holder](https://tokenholder.io): a data-sovereignty layer between AI agents and
  your data. Grant-gated access and signed audit trails.
- [Home Team Education](https://hometeameducation.org): youth financial-literacy curriculum
  and free resources.

## Shipped, with dates

Most of the underlying repositories are private, so these are stated with dates
and pull-request numbers rather than links.

- 2026-06-18: Beat The Odds launched to production at app.btofantasy.us. Bettor
  app, signup credit, referral flow, and a national venue catalog covering
  roughly 48,800 eligible venues across 16 cleared states. PRs #384-391.
  Co-Founder and CTO; architecture and delivery since 2022.
- 2026-08-09: fixed a venue application form that had returned HTTP 500 on every
  submission since launch. PR #569, verified end to end in a browser.
- 2026-08-10: City Crawl merged, PR #568. 2026-08-13: Ball Pit merged, PR #575.
  Four original arcade games inside the venue app, with the intellectual-property
  boundary asserted by a test file rather than by a comment.
- 2026-08-14: ran the MASS Lead Connect Operations Map end to end for the first
  time, turning a delivery previously estimated at roughly three days of
  hand-assembly into a single afternoon of human work.
- 2026-08-17: shipped a brand and media kit to the Beat The Odds organisation.
  62 static templates across 23 categories and 18 Remotion compositions.

## What is not claimed

Beat The Odds is live in production and has no revenue, no cash deposits, no
real-money bets placed, no signed venue agreements, and under 100 users. The
MASS Lead Connect Operations Map is listed and has been sold zero times and
delivered zero times. These are stated because an unstated zero reads as a
hidden one.
